title: Aeroplane with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <polygon points='10,55 45,48 45,55 18,62' fill='#3D7FD6'/>
  <polygon points='90,55 55,48 55,55 82,62' fill='#3D7FD6'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='78,30 92,26 92,44 80,42' fill='#E8553E'/>
  <!-- tail plane -->
  <polygon points='80,40 95,42 95,48 80,46' fill='#3D7FD6'/>
  <!-- fuselage -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='34' ry='13' fill='#F2F6FF'/>
  <!-- belly shade -->
  <path d='M18,48 Q50,62 82,48 Q50,56 18,48 Z' fill='#C9D6EC'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='17' cy='46' r='9' fill='#E8553E'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='42' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#3D7FD6'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='41' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#9FD8F5'/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='43' r='2.2' fill='#3D7FD6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='43' r='2.2' fill='#3D7FD6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='43' r='2.2' fill='#3D7FD6'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='43' r='2.2' fill='#3D7FD6'/>
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='49' r='2.6' fill='#2E2A5E'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='49' r='2.6' fill='#2E2A5E'/>
  <!-- face: smile -->
  <path d='M42,53 Q50,60 58,53' stroke='#2E2A5E' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='53' r='2' fill='#F7B2C4'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='53' r='2' fill='#F7B2C4'/>
</svg>
